description: This Java source file defines the `AcknowledgementAggregatorActor` class, an Akka actor responsible for collecting acknowledgements related to Thing modification commands within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It manages acknowledgement requests, handles responses and timeouts, and consolidates acknowledgements to produce a final aggregated result or error.

classes.name: AcknowledgementAggregatorActor
classes.description: An Akka actor that manages acknowledgement collection, handling responses, timeouts, and producing aggregated acknowledgements or error responses for thing modification commands.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Constructs the Akka Props object to instantiate an AcknowledgementAggregatorActor with specified parameters.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines the message handling logic for the actor, including responses to acknowledgements, responses, exceptions, and timeouts.

methods.name: handleThingCommandResponse
methods.description: Processes a response related to a specific thing command, determining if it is a live response and adding it to the acknowledgement aggregator.

methods.name: handleMessageCommandResponse
methods.description: Processes a message command response, marking it as a live response and adding it to the acknowledgement aggregator.

methods.name: addCommandResponse
methods.description: Adds a command response to the acknowledgement aggregator, logging details and extracting payloads as needed.

methods.name: getPayload
methods.description: Extracts payload data from various command response types.

methods.name: handleReceiveTimeout
methods.description: Handles timeout events when not all acknowledgements are received in time, completing with a timeout status.

methods.name: handleAcknowledgement
methods.description: Handles individual acknowledgement messages from the entity.

methods.name: handleAcknowledgements
methods.description: Processes multiple acknowledgements received at once.

methods.name: handleDittoRuntimeException
methods.description: Handles runtime exceptions, stopping the actor upon encountering such an error.

methods.name: potentiallyCompleteAcknowledgements
methods.description: Checks if all acknowledgements have been received and proceeds to complete the process if so.

methods.name: completeAcknowledgements
methods.description: Finalizes the acknowledgement collection, creating either an aggregated acknowledgement or an error response based on context.

methods.name: restoreCommandConnectivityHeaders
methods.description: Restores or modifies headers for command connectivity, copying relevant headers from request and signal.

methods.name: handleSignal
methods.description: Delivers the final signal (acknowledgement or error) using a consumer function.

methods.name: asThingErrorResponse
methods.description: Converts acknowledgements into a ThingErrorResponse indicating a timeout or failure.

methods.name: containsOnlyTwinPersistedOrLiveResponse
methods.description: Checks if the acknowledgements contain only certain types of responses.
